CEO PROFILE
大学卒業後、広告代理店を経て1987年よりビジネス誌系出版の株式会社ダイヤモンド社へ入社。2002年同社広告局企画部部長就任。
その後、株式会社セブンシーズアンドカンパニー取締役、株式会社エスクァイアマガジンジャパン執行役員と、富裕層向け高級誌「セブンシーズ」や海外提携誌の「エスクァイア日本版」「デパーチャーズ日本版」など広告部門のトップを歴任し、2006年、株式会社ブルズアイコミュニケーションズを設立。
After graduating University and worked for Advertising agency, he had been working at DIAMOND, INC., a business magazine publisher since 1987. In 2002, he became the director of advertising planning department.               After that, he has experienced to be a director of SevenSeas & Company, Ltd., and an executive officer of Esquire Magazine Japan Co., Ltd.              In addition, he has served as the head of the advertising department for "SevenSeas", which is a luxury magazine for wealthy people, and overseas affiliate magazines "Esquire Japan" and then "DEPARTURES Japan".              In 2006, he founded BULLSEYE COMMUNICATIONS Inc.
